en.x: Mersal Foundation is a non-profit charitable organization dedicated to providing high-quality healthcare services to those in need across Egypt and the Arab world. Founded on the principles of compassion, equity, and excellence, Mersal works to bridge the gaps in the healthcare system by offering comprehensive medical care that is not covered by public services.
To deliver all types of medical care to underserved individuals with dignity, privacy, and without discrimination—ensuring that every patient receives the treatment they deserve.
A society where every person has access to quality healthcare, regardless of their financial status, background, or medical condition.
Patient First: The patient is our top priority in every decision and action.
Privacy: We uphold the highest standards of confidentiality for all medical and personal information.
Non-Discrimination: We serve all patients equally, regardless of religion, nationality, color, or language.
High Quality: Our services are delivered by highly qualified medical professionals and institutions.
Transparency: We openly disclose our sources of income and expenditures, including donations and operational costs.
Mersal Foundation operates through a network of contracted hospitals and doctors to provide a wide range of medical services, including:
Mersal Charitable Hospital for Children: Egypt’s first charitable pediatric hospital, currently under construction.
Mersal Oncology Center: Comprehensive cancer care for patients who cannot access treatment elsewhere.
Mersal Guest House: Accommodation for patients traveling from outside Cairo or abroad for treatment.
Hekayat Sawt Project: Support for children with hearing impairments through cochlear implants and rehabilitation.
Emergency Program: 24/7 urgent medical assistance through a dedicated hotline and hospital network.
Dialysis Center: Ongoing dialysis services for patients in need.
Monthly Treatment Program: Regular medication support for over 5,000 patients.
Mental Health Program: Free psychological support for patients and their families.
Support Convoys: Medical outreach to underserved areas and public hospitals, including relief efforts for Gaza.
Mersal Foundation is committed to opening the door to new hope for every patient. We believe that healthcare is a right, not a privilege—and we work every day to make that belief a reality.

en.x: Mersal Campaign to Support Incubators for Newborn & Premature Babies
"I was born early... before the world was ready for me. I need an incubator to protect me until I grow."

Sometimes we arrive before our time, and find the place isn't ready yet. That is what happens to a premature baby: they come into the world before their development is complete, and need special care and extra protection to begin their journey safely.
An incubator is not a luxury; it is a chance at life. A baby who arrived early cannot wait, and every night spent in the incubator makes a difference to their health and future.

Mersal works to close the shortage of newborn incubators in Egypt by providing specialized medical care of uncompromising quality, and expanding incubator capacity until the service reaches every child who needs it.
Today, Mersal provides incubator services through two centers in Faisal and Maadi.
Our Latest Medical Project: Maadi Incubator Center
In celebration of our latest medical project, Mersal has opened a specialized center for newborn and premature babies in Maadi:
7 incubators in each ward, with 350 m² per ward
All days of the week, with two shifts daily
For cases requiring separation, per infection-control standards
Our Achievements in the First 9 Months of 2026
Be the Reason a Baby Born Early Lives
Your donation to incubators is an ongoing charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), its impact lasting as long as the child breathes and grows.
Mersal Charity & Development Foundation | Born Early

ar.x: مرض الـ PKU هو أحد أمراض التمثيل الغذائي والتي يتم اكتشافها في الأسابيع الأولى من ولادة الطفل، وهو مرض مُكلف ماديا، لأن الطفل المصاب به يكون غير قادرا على تحمل الأطعمة المعتادة مثل: الخبز والمعكرونة والأرز وغيرها من منتجات القمح التي تحتوي على الأحماض الأمينية وبالتالي تتكلف الأسرة الغير قادرة عبء مادي كبير لتوفير أنواع محددة من الأغذية الخاصة المناسبة لهذا الطفل.

ماذا تقدم مرسال لدعم أطفال الPKU؟
كرتونة مجانية بها الاحتياج الشهري للأطعمة الخاصة بالمرضى .

en.x: PKU is a metabolic disease that is discovered in the first weeks of a child’s birth, and it is a costly disease, because the affected child is unable to tolerate the usual foods such as: bread, pasta, rice and other wheat products that contain amino acids and thus cost A family who is unable to provide a large financial burden to provide specific types of special foods suitable for this child.
Failure to treat these cases quickly leads to complications, including: intellectual disability, behavioral and mental disorders, and seizures.
What does Mersal offer to support PKU children?
A free carton containing the monthly need for patients' foods.

en.x: Patients suffer from diseases that must be treated with surgical intervention, to preserve their lives, prevent any possible complications or to get rid of pain due to this disease,Mersal provides surgical services for patients who are unable to do so through a network of hospitals that Mirsal has contracted with to carry out these operations, regardless of the cost.
Number of operations carried out by Mersal during 2021: - 144 operations

ar.x: قد يقع العبء المادي على المرضى بشكل يمنعهم من القدرة على السداد وذلك بسبب ارتفاع تكلفة الخدمات الطبية أو عدم قدرة المريض على العمل؛ فيصبح معرضًا للسجن.
تقوم مرسال بسداد الديون عن المرضى والتي نتجت ديونهم عن المرض.

en.x: The financial burden may fall on patients in a way that prevents them from being able to pay due to the high cost of medical services or the patient’s inability to work; He is liable to imprisonment.
Mersal pays the debts of the patients whose debts resulted from the disease.

ar.x: قد لا تتوفر الأجهزة المساعدة التي يحتاجها المريض حال إصابته بإعاقة جسدية، ومع عدم توافر الأجهزة المساعدة قد تتوقف حياة البعض؛ فتقوم مرسال بمساعدة الأسر غير القادرة بتوفير الأجهزة المساعدة، وفحص وصيانة أي أجهزة يستخدمها المريض.

en.x: The assistive devices that the patient needs may not be available if he has a physical disability, and with the lack of assistive devices, the lives of some may stop; Mirsal helps families who are unable to provide assistive devices, and checks and maintains any devices used by the patient.

ar.x: تحاول مرسال تقديم خدمة تكاملية للمرضى وتسعى لتحسين الحياة ولهذا تقوم من خلال مشروع الكفالات للمرضى بتوفير مساعدات شهرية يتم تقديمها للمرضى لحين الشفاء أو القدرة على العمل لتغطية احتياجات الأسرة، فإصابة أحد الأفراد بمرض قد يستنزف كافة الموارد المادية للأسرة، وقد يكون المرض عائقًا لعمل رب العائلة فيصبح غير قادرًا على توفير الاحتياجات الأساسية للمعيشة.

en.x: Mersal is trying to provide an integrated service to patients and seeks to improve life. For this reason, through the sponsorship project for patients, it provides monthly aid to patients until recovery or the ability to work to cover the needs of the family. The disease of an individual may drain all the material resources of the family, and the disease may be an obstacle to the work of the head of the family. It becomes unable to provide for the basic needs of living.
